per_item_plan.name: One site-plan sheet
per_item_plan.finding: emitPdfSitePlan (render.ts:2596-2758) unconditionally emits drawing + all SUMMARY pages + one AERIAL page (3+ sheets; EmitPdfSitePlanOptions has no sheet-selection field). authorParcelPropertyDossierExport (dossier-author.ts:104-107) always passes the full composed model to emitPdfDossier's sitePlan option, which always appends whatever emitPdfSitePlan returns. There is no existing seam to request just the drawing sheet.
per_item_plan.disposition: CODE CHANGE. Add a sheet-selection option to emitPdfSitePlan (e.g. `sheets: "all" | "drawing-only"`, default "all" to avoid breaking the standalone site-plan-export route which still wants all sheets) that, when "drawing-only", emits only the page-1 SITE PLAN drawing sheet. Add a matching counting path (countSitePlanSheets equivalent for drawing-only = 1) so dossier.ts's renumbering math (dossierPageCount + sitePlanSheets = total) stays correct. Wire emitPdfDossier's sitePlan option to request drawing-only, and thread that intent from authorParcelPropertyDossierExport. Standalone pdf-site-plan export route is untouched (still gets all sheets).

per_item_plan.name: No UNAVAILABLE chips on aerials and bound sheets
per_item_plan.finding: render.ts:2508, drawAerialPage's header stats row: `[{label:"IMAGERY",value:"ESRI"}, {label:"CAPTURED", chip: CHIP_UNAVAILABLE}, registerStat]` -- the CAPTURED stat is UNCONDITIONALLY the chip, never computed, never wired to any real ESRI capture-date field (unlike REGISTER right next to it, which computes computeRegistrationToleranceFeet and only chips when that returns null). This is a dead stub, not an honest per-case absence -- it fires on every single aerial sheet regardless of data availability. No literal 'bound sheet' exists in render.ts (only SITE PLAN / SUMMARY / AERIAL); 'bound packet' in the cited QA item (W4.P3) most likely means the whole bound PDF document, not a fourth sheet kind. The SUMMARY sheet's own KV-row chips (render.ts:1497,1544) are the same honest-absence-row pattern used throughout dossier.ts and are NOT named as defective by any acceptance item.
per_item_plan.disposition: CODE CHANGE (confirmed piece) + LIVE READ (open question). Remove the CAPTURED stat from the aerial header row entirely (drop the always-chipping stub rather than fabricate a value ESRI World Imagery does not reliably expose per-tile) -- IMAGERY + REGISTER remain, REGISTER's existing computed-or-chip logic is untouched. Before closing this item, generate a real PDF for 48021:34161 and read the bytes (per the item's own check instruction) to confirm no other chip fires on the aerial or summary-as-appended-to-dossier sheets that would contradict the honest-absence design; if one is found, it gets its own citation and fix rather than being folded in silently.

per_item_plan.name: Engine hollow download refuse
per_item_plan.finding: parcel-terrain.ts:491-513, GET /:parcelNodeId/dossier-export/download. Existing check (496): `if (!artifact || artifact.deferred) return 404`. This part is ALREADY fail-closed (unlike the P-89 MCP-side bug I fixed earlier this session -- hauska-engine's own artifact record here is authored directly by dossier-author.ts, which always sets verdictIncluded/briefFactCount on write, so the undefined-record class of bug does not reproduce the same way). But there is NO check at all for the hollow-but-present case (verdictIncluded===false or briefFactCount===0) before streaming bytes at line 512 -- a stored artifact that IS present but records a hollow dossier streams unconditionally today. hauska-engine has no isStoredDossierArtifactHollow-equivalent function anywhere (repo-wide search, zero hits) -- no shared package with hauska-mcp-server; this needs its own small function here.
per_item_plan.disposition: CODE CHANGE. Add a local hollow check in parcel-terrain.ts (or a small exported helper beside the route) applied after the existing !artifact/deferred check: refuse (422, not 404, to match the MCP-side error shape family and distinguish from genuinely-missing) when `artifact.verdictIncluded === false || (artifact.briefFactCount ?? 0) === 0`, before the artifactStore.get/stream. Mirrors the fail-closed lesson from the P-89 leftover (undefined defaults to hollow=true) even though this route's own !artifact branch already covers that case.
